rca_of_the_issue: Hardcoded X-dependent prompt examples bypass server-side sanitizer: iter4-era SUGGESTIONS array in New.jsx and example chip arrays in Home.jsx predate the sanitizer scrubbing of social/post_match signal kinds and @elonmusk/x.com strings. When a user clicks '@elonmusk posts about Dogecoin, long DOGE 5x with $100', the thesis is sent to the upstream AI which drafts a strategy using the social/post_match signal — the response then passes through _sanitize_upstream which strips those keys/kinds, leaving the user with an incomplete or empty strategy. Reproduction: open /new signed out, click the elonmusk chip, press Draft the rules (after quota resets). Mitigation: replace the 4 hardcoded locations (Home.jsx:14, Home.jsx:266, New.jsx:15-21, New.jsx:179) with crypto-only examples. No backend code change needed — sanitizer behavior is correct; this is purely a frontend copy regression.
